description: This file defines functions and declarations related to graph optimization and manipulation within the Torch JIT tensor expression framework, including optimization of 'aten::cat' operations, graph trimming, shape symbolization, and graph analysis.

methods.name: OptimizeCat
methods.description: Optimizes tensor concatenation operations in the graph by moving user operations into inputs to inline and reduce intermediate buffers.

methods.name: annotateInputShapes
methods.description: Annotates input tensor shapes in the graph with static or symbolic shape information.

methods.name: removeUnusedSelfArgument
methods.description: Removes unused 'self' arguments from the graph if present.

methods.name: removeGraphOutput
methods.description: Removes the output at the specified index from the graph.

methods.name: replaceListOutputWithTuple
methods.description: Replaces list outputs in the graph with tuple outputs for better handling.

methods.name: trimGraph
methods.description: Performs iterative trimming of the graph to produce minimal reproductions for debugging.

methods.name: makeShapesSymbolic
methods.description: Converts specific dimension sizes in the graph to symbolic variables for analysis.

methods.name: isGraphCompilable
methods.description: Checks whether the graph can be compiled into Tensor Expression (TE) IR.

methods.name: fixupMissingShapeInfo
methods.description: Attempts to fill in missing tensor shape and type information in the graph.
